brief: 5 ways to kill self-doubt before it kills you.

slots.title: SELF-DOUBT IS KILLING YOU FIGHT BACK NOW
NAME THE INNER CRITIC NOW
slots.body: Self-doubt thrives in anonymity. Give it a ridiculous name and watch its power dissolve instantly.

slots.title: MOVE BEFORE YOU FEEL READY
slots.body: Confidence follows action, not the other way around. Take one imperfect step today and let momentum rebuild your belief.

slots.title: STACK PROOF YOU ARE CAPABLE
slots.body: Your brain deletes wins to protect you from risk. Write down three past victories and read them when fear speaks.

slots.title: CUT WHAT FEEDS YOUR FEAR
slots.body: Audit who and what you consume daily. If it amplifies your anxiety, mute it without apology or second thought.

slots.title: PLAY OUT THE WORST CASE
slots.body: Ask yourself what truly happens if you fail. Usually the cost is embarrassment, not death, and that is survivable.

slots.title: USE THE THIRD PERSON TRICK
slots.body: Using your name instead of I creates distance. This simple language shift reduces emotional intensity and restores logical control.

slots.headline: START WITH ONE TODAY
slots.body: Save this post and pick one tactic to use before noon. Your future self is waiting.
